items.title: Crown-Shaped Ornamental Gourd
items.alt: A cream-and-green striped ornamental gourd has a flattened center and a ring of projecting crown-like lobes around its sides.
items.description: A cream-and-green striped ornamental gourd has a flattened center and a ring of projecting crown-like lobes around its sides. An original gourd illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.
